title: UFO claims raised on the floor of Congress
summary: James Madden tells of UFO claims raised on the floor of Congress, about Unspecified (recent) at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I I mean I it's been on the floor of the Congress and things like that that it has to that's got to pump the probability up a little bit, right?

plain: A guest named James Madden, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels about consciousness and UFOs, points out that UFO claims have been raised on the floor of the US Congress. He says that fact has to make the claims seem a bit more likely to be true.
